plugins.name: swe-flow
plugins.description: LLM authoring companion to the govkit governance engine: skills and role agents that author the governed SDLC chain (PRD/RFC/ADR/US, API + data design, gate-loop close-out) and call `npx govkit verify` — never embedding the deterministic gate. Domain modelling lives in the sibling ddd-flow plugin, experience design in design-flow; siblings meet at artifacts, never imports.

plugins.name: ddd-flow
plugins.description: The DDD modelling loop as skills: one orchestrator (/ddd-flow:design) reads repo state and decides the next step, eight hidden step skills own the workshops, and /ddd-flow:view renders the whole model live in the browser. Episodic by design — greenfield projects and DDD migrations. Hands off to swe-flow through docs/domain/; authors drafts, never flips a status.

plugins.name: design-flow
plugins.description: The experience-design loop: ui-designer authors docs/ui (design brief, WCAG-validated tokens, screen inventory with declared states — RFC-0030) and /design-flow:view runs the live co-design surface whose clicks, notes, and candidate picks land in events.jsonl for the agent's next round. Meets ddd-flow at docs/domain/ and swe-flow at docs/ui/; authors drafts, never flips a status.
